import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))

# Color palette for species
colors = {'setosa': '#FF6B6B', 'versicolor': '#4ECDC4', 'virginica': '#45B7D1'}

# 1. Pairplot-style scatter: Petal Length vs Petal Width
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
for species in df['species'].unique():
    subset = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax1.scatter(subset['petal_length'], subset['petal_width'], 
                label=species, alpha=0.7, s=80, c=colors[species], edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax1.set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Petal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.legend(title='Species', loc='upper left', frameon=True, shadow=True)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 2. Sepal Length vs Sepal Width
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
for species in df['species'].unique():
    subset = df[df['species'] == species]
    ax2.scatter(subset['sepal_length'], subset['sepal_width'], 
                label=species, alpha=0.7, s=80, c=colors[species], edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax2.set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Sepal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.legend(title='Species', loc='upper right', frameon=True, shadow=True)
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. Box plot for all measurements
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
data_to_plot = pd.melt(df, id_vars=['species'], 
                        value_vars=['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width'],
                        var_name='Measurement', value_name='Value (cm)')
sns.boxplot(data=data_to_plot, x='Measurement', y='Value (cm)', hue='species', 
            palette=colors, ax=ax3, linewidth=1.5)
ax3.set_xlabel('Measurement Type', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Value (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Distribution of Measurements Across Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax3.set_xticklabels(['Sepal\nLength', 'Sepal\nWidth', 'Petal\nLength', 'Petal\nWidth'], fontsize=9)
ax3.legend(title='Species', loc='upper left', frameon=True, shadow=True)
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 4. Violin plot for petal length (most discriminative feature)
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
sns.violinplot(data=df, x='species', y='petal_length', palette=colors, 
               ax=ax4, linewidth=1.5, inner='quartile')
ax4.set_xlabel('Species', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Petal Length Distribution by Species', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# Add mean values as text
for i, species in enumerate(df['species'].unique()):
    mean_val = df[df['species'] == species]['petal_length'].mean()
    ax4.text(i, mean_val, f'μ={mean_val:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom', 
             fontweight='bold', fontsize=9, bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', 
             facecolor='white', edgecolor='gray', alpha=0.8))

# Overall title
fig.suptitle('Iris Dataset: Comprehensive Analysis of Flower Measurements', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 1, 0.99])
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
